splits.test: 41-50; do not read until classifier and validation decision are frozen

timebase: Author helper str2seconds: absolute hh:mm:ss.ms, hours below 12 add 24; subtract the same subject annotation.record_start. No guessed shift or duration rescaling. Offset provenance is author-supplied, not independently measured.
window: 90 seconds of actual mono PCM: preceding 30 seconds, central target epoch of 30 seconds, following 30 seconds. Require all samples within published WAV data bounds. Blank/unknown target labels and missing/gapped input remain absent.

selection.train: For each subject and mapped class, ascending hash order; accept up to 2 centers, requiring at least 90 seconds between any accepted centers for that subject. Class order is the declared class_order. No selection by acoustic features or classifier score.
selection.validation: Per subject, ascending hash order independent of labels; accept up to 10 centers with at least 90 seconds separation. Do not replace selected invalid/silent windows with other windows.
selection.test: Same selection as validation, using split=test, after model freeze. No retuning from these results.

features.input: Actual released mono PCM16 at 8000 Hz only. Other formats require explicit protocol revision before fitting.
per_30_second_block: 32 triangular HTK Mel bands (2595log10(1+f/700)),50-3500Hz; periodic Hann FFT512,hop160,no padding; squared FFT magnitudes divided by Hann squared sum192; mean and population standard deviation of log10(power+1e-12)
Mean and standard deviation of frame spectral centroid, flatness and zero crossing rate
Normalized RMS-envelope autocorrelation at 1/2/3/4/5/6 second lags
features.combine: Concatenate the three blocks in chronological order. No stage label, subject ID, clock, elapsed-night position, AHI, annotation event, SpO2, HR or EEG is a model feature.
features.missing: Reject a context with nonfinite samples, incomplete samples, or more than 10 seconds of exact-zero 250ms frames in any 30-second block; report missing coverage, without zero padding or stage guesses.

classifier.search: One fixed fit; no hyperparameter search or test-driven threshold adjustment. No clock-cycle smoothing or forced stage diversity.

report: Publish attempted/accepted/missing windows and subjects, input/feature/model hashes, class counts, raw probabilities, confusion matrix, per-class recall, macro F1, balanced accuracy, and a train-majority baseline on identical validation/test targets. A fitted model alone does not establish useful phone estimates. Do not ship a collapsed or unhelpful model; no clinical-certification gate is added.
prospective_validation_gate: Before TEST may be opened: at least80percent selected validation windows have actual usable input; macro F1 exceeds the train-majority baseline by at least.05; balanced accuracy at least.35; positive recall for every declared class and all4 predicted classes. These are a modest experimental prototype gate, not clinical accuracy claims. No test-driven adjustment or forced output diversity is permitted.
acquisition_budget: Initial total remains <=100MB until parent authorizes expansion. Requested ceiling for new TRAIN+VAL PCM is489600000bytes plus bounded metadata; TEST is a separate later <=144000000byte acquisition after model freeze. Never download50complete WAVs.
